The use item script has now been reduced to only 2 if/elses, everything else has been moved into their own entity scripts
i also moved uncle sambie attack and imitate script to entity scripts

I also switched most of the if/elses in the attribute == 0 script into their units too
And i made the zombieAmount variable automatically count every AI zombie in the game so hopefully that fixes any bugs (in every frame script)
also every item will use the damage attribute for damage
you can also put the damage attribute on projectiles but it will check the projectile first then item second
this also applies to the speed attribute
main reason this isn't in 'every second (main)' is because this is a script for events ONLY. (so its easier for us to access and edit. in other words: this isn't a major script.)
